**[[Papiri kidnapping]]
***[[Nigeria]]n [[President of Nigeria|presidential]] spokesperson [[Ajuri Ngelale]] reports that all remaining 130 students and staff abducted in November from a [[Catholic school]] in [[Niger State]] have been released. '''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Extremaduran regional election]]
**In [[Extremadura]], [[Spain]], the ruling [[People's Party of Extremadura]] of [[President of the Regional Government of Extremadura|regional president]] [[María Guardiola]] wins the elections for its first time since 2011, while [[Spanish Socialist Workers' Party of Extremadura|PSOE Extremadura]] reports its worst result ever and the [[History of the far-right in Spain|far-right]] [[Vox (political party)|Vox]] party more than doubles its share of the vote.
